title: Mnyambuliko wa (Theme 8: Wanyama wa majini)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child extends the verb for each other (-eana: pikiana), causing (-esha/-isha: somesha) and undoing (-ua: fungua), choosing by meaning.
steps: Ask: for each other, cause, or undo?
Check it is a real word.
contexts: water animals (wanyama wa majini): fish caught and released

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "anatusomesha" and one sentence with -eana.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Majirani hao ___ chakula kila Jumapili. (kila mmoja humpikia mwenzake)" Kwa nini "hupika" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kitenzi cha kawaida hakionyeshi kwamba kila mmoja anamtendea mwenzake. Kutendeana: hupikiana.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Otieno na Achieng ___ barua kila mwezi." Kwa nini "huandikia" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Mwalimu ___ watoto kuimba wimbo mpya. (huwafanya waimbe)" Kwa nini "huimbiana" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: -ana ni kila mmoja kwa mwenzake, -isha ni kumfanya mtu atende, na -ua ni kufanya kinyume.
Kutendua hubadilisha tendo kuwa kinyume chake: funga -> fungua; si kila kitenzi kina kutendua.
